drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 45-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.8, creatinine 0.89, hemoglobin 13.1, pao2 56, platelets 228, sodium 138, wbc 8.9; vitals dbp 70-74, heart_rate 71-76, map 88-92, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 27-31, sbp 121-128, spo2 86-94, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 224, sodium 138, wbc 9.5; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 71-77, map 87-91, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 21-26, sbp 121-125, spo2 93-94, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 45-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Hypertension. Not in respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
